welcome_body: TDrive keeps your files in a private channel on your own Telegram account. There is no TDrive server in between, so you sign in with your own API credentials and phone number.
setup_mobile_after: and copy its API ID and API hash here.
setup_desktop_intro: Use API credentials created for your own Telegram account.
setup_step_1_rest: and sign in with your phone number.
setup_step_2: Choose API development tools, then create an app.
setup_step_3: Set Platform to Desktop, click Create application, then copy the API ID and API hash.
setup_storage_mobile: TDrive ships without API credentials because Telegram limits keys shared across many installs. Yours stay in the app's private storage on this phone.
setup_storage_desktop: Credentials and your Telegram session stay in TDrive's private app-data folder on this device. TDrive has no analytics or external tracking.
phone_intro: Telegram will send a login code to your account.
phone_hint: Use the number linked to your Telegram account.
phone_session_note: Your signed-in session is kept locally on this device and is not synced by TDrive.
code_intro: Enter the login code Telegram sent you.
code_two_step_note: If your account has two-step verification, Telegram will ask for your password next.
password_intro: Enter your Telegram password to finish signing in.
country_empty: No countries found. Try a country name or calling code.
phone_err_empty: Enter the phone number for your Telegram account.
phone_err_chars: Enter a phone number using digits and an optional leading +.
phone_err_intl: Check your country code and phone number.
phone_err_no_country: Choose a country or enter your full number starting with +.
phone_err_invalid: Check the phone number for the selected country.
drive_scan_wait: Telegram asked us to slow down, resuming in {seconds}s
drive_retry_hint: Continues the previous attempt without creating a duplicate channel.
drive_confirm_detail: This creates one new Telegram channel.
drive_setup_intro: No saved drive was found on this device. Pick the Telegram channel that holds your files, or start a new empty drive.
drive_loading_detail: Checking the channels you created on Telegram
drive_no_channels_detail: You haven't created any Telegram channels, so there is nothing to recover yet.
